results.title: Alien Isolation 2's PS5 Release Window May Have Been Narrowed
results.description: Sequel will get a physical release. Alien Isolation 2 will get a physical disc, implying a 2027 release window could be on the table for the anticipated sequel. As you all know, Sony will cease manufacturing games on disc in January 2028, which means publisher SEGA wouldn’t be able to release a boxed version for the PS5 beyond that date. Read the full article on pushsquare.com
